raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

  Fixes a streaming/non-streaming mismatch in the Qwen3/MiMo engine tool parser.
  When an open `<parameter` opener is split across chunks, the partial opener was
  streamed into `arguments`; the non-partial converter drops it. Streamed tool
  calls could therefore carry an extra key or a truncated value.

  No existing issue: found by differential testing of the streaming and
  non-streaming parser paths.

  ## Claims

  - Streaming arguments now equal non-streaming arguments for split
    next-parameter openers: `<parameter=`, `<parameter =`, `<parameter\t=`.
  - Partial parameter names that swallowed `</parameter` are dropped consistently
    with `partial=False`.
  - The incremental (O(N)) arg-extender path is preserved.

  ## Validation

  Before (master, server-facing `parse_delta(..., finished=True)`):

  | value | non-stream | streamed |
  |---|---|---|
  | `a<parameter=b` | `{"k": "a"}` | `{"k": "a", "b</parameter": ""` |
  | `a<parameter =b` | `{"k": "a"}` | `{"k": "a<parameter "` |
  | `a<parameter\t=b` | `{"k": "a"}` | `{"k": "a<parameter\t` |

  After: all three are `{"k": "a"}`.

  Commands run:

  ```bash
  pytest tests/parser/engine -q
  # 6101 passed in 38.93s (Python 3.12, torch 2.14.0+cpu, 5a822a3c7e on 16d66734)

  pytest tests/parser/engine/test_qwen3.py -q
  # 94 passed in 1.44s

  Additional differential fuzzing: 20,000 random values/chunk sizes plus
  schema-aware coercion fuzzing, 0 streaming/non-streaming mismatches.

  The new regression test test_streaming_holds_partial_next_parameter
  exercises the server-facing parse_delta(finished=True) path for both qwen3
  and MiMo, with 4 malformed values and 5 chunk sizes. It fails 8/8 on master
  before the fix and passes after.

  Local pre-commit: ruff-check and ruff-format pass. The full pre-commit run
  could not install the actionlint Go environment because this machine cannot
  reach proxy.golang.org; this is unrelated to the changed Python files.

  No model evaluation is included: this change only affects how already-generated
  text is parsed in streaming mode, not model weights, logits, or sampling. The
  parser output-equivalence tests above cover the behavior change.

  Details

  _param_value_extender assumed the trailing potential-tag window had already
  been emitted, so it either leaked that window (when it completed as a tag) or
  dropped it (when it did not). _split_open_value() now separates the stable
  prefix from the pending suffix; the pending suffix is held until it is known
  not to be a tag. The partial converter uses the same split, and malformed
  partial names containing </ are skipped so they match the non-partial
  converter.

  Related: #55497 tightens the parameter-name regex and fixes the <parameter=b
  name-swallow variant. I applied its regex-only change locally and confirmed it
  still leaves <parameter =b and <parameter\t=b leaking the opener into the
  streamed value; this change covers both. If #55497 lands first, I will rebase
  and keep the holdback logic.

  AI assistance was used (CodeBuddy Code). The human submitter reviewed every
  changed line and ran the tests above.

  Checklist

  ☒ I used vLLM's /pr-checklist skill.
  ☒ AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
  ☒ Design Fit
  ☒ Testing and Validation
  ☒ Code Quality and Style
  ☒ Pull Request Contents

What's left are whitespace-only parameter names like `<parameter=\t>`, which differ the same way on main.

@@ -23,6 +23,7 @@
 from vllm.parser.qwen3 import (
     TOOL_CALL_END,
     TOOL_CALL_START,
+    Qwen3Parser,
     qwen3_config,
 )
 
@@ -1008,15 +1009,51 @@ def test_extender_follows_newline_trimming_and_split_end(self):
         extend = _qwen3_arg_value_extender("<parameter=k>")
         assert extend is not None
         deltas = ["\n", 'a"\n', "b", "\n", "</param", "eter>"]
-        expected = ["", 'a\\"', "\\nb", "", "\\n</param", None]
+        expected = ["", 'a\\"', "\\nb", "", "", None]
         assert [extend(d) for d in deltas] == expected
 
     def test_extender_stops_at_split_next_parameter(self):
         from vllm.parser.qwen3 import _qwen3_arg_value_extender
 
         extend = _qwen3_arg_value_extender("<parameter=k>x")
         assert extend is not None
-        assert [extend(d) for d in ["< para", "meter ="]] == ["< para", None]
+        assert [extend(d) for d in ["< para", "meter ="]] == ["", None]
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("parser_name", ["qwen3", "mimo"])
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
+        "value",
+        ["a<parameter=b", "a<parameter =b", "a<parameter\t=b", "a<param<parameter=b"],
+    )
+    def test_streaming_holds_partial_next_parameter(
+        self, mock_tokenizer, mock_request, parser_name, value
+    ):
+        from vllm.parser.mimo import MiMoParser
+
+        cls = MiMoParser if parser_name == "mimo" else Qwen3Parser
+        text = (
+            "<tool_call>\n<function=f>\n"
+            f"<parameter=k>{value}</parameter>\n"
+            "</function>\n</tool_call>"
+        )
+        expected = cls(
+            mock_tokenizer, chat_template_kwargs={"enable_thinking": False}
+        ).extract_tool_calls(text, mock_request)
+        assert expected.tool_calls[0].function.arguments
+
+        for chunk_size in (1, 2, 3, 5):
+            parser = cls(
+                mock_tokenizer, chat_template_kwargs={"enable_thinking": False}
+            )
+            chunks = [text[i : i + chunk_size] for i in range(0, len(text), chunk_size)]
+            streamed = ""
+            for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
+                delta = parser.parse_delta(
+                    chunk, [], mock_request, finished=i == len(chunks) - 1
+                )
+                for tool_call in (delta.tool_calls if delta else None) or []:
+                    if tool_call.function and tool_call.function.arguments:
+                        streamed += tool_call.function.arguments
+            assert streamed == expected.tool_calls[0].function.arguments
 
     @pytest.mark.parametrize(
         "raw_args",

@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@
     CHATML_TURN_BOUNDARIES,
     Qwen3Parser,
     _param_value_extender,
+    _split_open_value,
     qwen3_config,
 )
 
@@ -20,8 +21,9 @@ def _mimo_arg_converter(raw_args: str, partial: bool) -> str:
     params = {m.group(1): m.group(2) for m in _PARAM_RE.finditer(raw_args)}
     if partial:
         match = _PARTIAL_PARAM_RE.search(_PARAM_RE.sub("", raw_args))
-        if match and match.group(1):
-            params[match.group(1)] = match.group(2)
+        if match and match.group(1) and "</" not in match.group(1):
+            stable, _ = _split_open_value(match.group(2), trim_newlines=False)
+            params[match.group(1)] = stable
     return json.dumps(params, ensure_ascii=False)

@@ -120,8 +120,15 @@ def _qwen3_arg_converter(
     raw_args: str, partial: bool, closed: _ClosedParams | None = None
 ) -> str:
     params, open_param = _qwen3_parse_params(raw_args, partial, closed)
-    if open_param is not None and open_param.group(1):
-        params[open_param.group(1)] = _trim_wrapping_newlines(open_param.group(2))
+    if open_param is not None:
+        name = open_param.group(1)
+        # A closing tag swallowed into the name means the opener was never
+        # closed; the non-partial converter drops this malformed parameter.
+        if name and "</" not in name:
+            value = open_param.group(2)
+            pending = _param_value_end_window(value)
+            stable = value[: len(value) - len(pending)] if pending else value
+            params[name] = _trim_wrapping_newlines(stable)
 
     return json.dumps(params, ensure_ascii=False)
 
@@ -139,6 +146,26 @@ def _param_value_end_window(text: str) -> str:
     return tail if _PARAM_VALUE_END_RE.fullmatch(tail, partial=True) else ""
 
 
+def _split_open_value(value: str, trim_newlines: bool) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Split an open value into stream-stable text and a pending suffix.
+
+    A suffix that can still grow into a closing tag or the next parameter
+    opener is not stable: emitting it would leak text that the converter drops
+    when the tag completes. With *trim_newlines*, a trailing newline of the
+    stable part moves into the pending suffix, so it is emitted only if the
+    suffix turns out not to be a tag.
+    """
+    pending = _param_value_end_window(value)
+    stable = value if not pending else value[: len(value) - len(pending)]
+    if trim_newlines:
+        if stable.startswith("\n"):
+            stable = stable[1:]
+        if stable.endswith("\n"):
+            stable = stable[:-1]
+            pending = "\n" + pending
+    return stable, pending
+
+
 def _param_value_extender(
     raw_args: str, trim_newlines: bool, closed: _ClosedParams | None = None
 ) -> ArgValueExtender | None:
@@ -152,30 +179,32 @@ def _param_value_extender(
     if match is None:
         return None
     name, value = match.group(1), match.group(2)
+    if "</" in name:
+        return None
     # A repeated key keeps its first position, so its value is not last.
     if name in closed_params:
         return None
 
-    window = _param_value_end_window(value)
+    _, pending = _split_open_value(value, trim_newlines)
     started = bool(value)
-    held = "\n" if trim_newlines and value.endswith("\n") and value != "\n" else ""
 
     def extend(delta: str) -> str | None:
-        nonlocal window, started, held
-        text = window + delta
+        nonlocal pending, started
+        text = pending + delta
         if _PARAM_VALUE_END_RE.search(text):
             return None
-        window = _param_value_end_window(text)
+        pending = _param_value_end_window(text)
+        stable = text[: len(text) - len(pending)]
         if trim_newlines:
-            text = held + delta
-            if not started and text:
+            if not started and stable:
                 started = True
-                text = text.removeprefix("\n")
-            held = "\n" if text.endswith("\n") else ""
-            text = text[: len(text) - len(held)]
-        else:
-            text = delta
-        return json.dumps(text, ensure_ascii=False)[1:-1]
+                stable = stable.removeprefix("\n")
+            if stable.endswith("\n"):
+                stable = stable[:-1]
+                pending = "\n" + pending
+        if not stable:
+            return ""
+        return json.dumps(stable, ensure_ascii=False)[1:-1]
 
     return extend
